text:
The abstract reports general benefits of nanofluids in machining—reduced friction, enhanced tool life, improved heat transfer, and discusses atomization mechanisms and parameter‑performance mapping. However, it does not provide evidence for the specific formulations, magnetic field conditions, surfactant mixes, or process parameters described in any of the four candidate hypotheses. Consequently, none of the hypotheses are directly supported by the study’s reported evidence.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
